title: Forgetting-the-negation
description: The reduct functor U : Bilattice → Pre-bilattice as data. A single bilattice instance is mapped to the pre-bilattice obtained by dropping the negating (and conflating, if present) operation tables.

domain.description: A bilattice instance conforming to bilattice.schema.json.

codomain.description: The pre-bilattice obtained by forgetting negation (and conflation if present). Conforms to pre-bilattice.schema.json. The script computes this from domain by stripping the negating and conflating fields.
